Where does a message enter?

A new order enters the service through one HTTP route. The table names this entry point and links to its flow.

order.mmd:1 flowchart

httpPOST /ordersorder

What happens to a new order?

The controller takes the order body and checks the total. A valid order is charged, saved and sent to Kafka.
